learning_objective_summary: Media Analytics dimulai dari business question, bukan dashboard atau file data yang kebetulan tersedia. Pertanyaan harus menentukan unit analisis, periode, population, outcome, diagnostic metrics, guardrails, dan keputusan yang akan diambil. KPI architecture menghubungkan business outcomes dengan driver seperti spend, reach, qualified traffic, conversion, revenue, margin, and retention. Definisi metric wajib menyebut formula, denominator, source, timezone, attribution window, owner, and limitation.

Grain harus diketahui sebelum join: campaign-day, ad-day, session, user, order, atau SKU. Taxonomy menstandarkan channel, campaign, market, audience, objective, and creative. Data quality memeriksa completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, accuracy, and timeliness.

GA4 berorientasi event/session/user; platform Ads mengoptimasi dan melaporkan menurut model internal; CM360/ad server merekam delivery, clicks, and Floodlight activities. Analyst harus memahami dimension, metric, event parameter, attribution setting, modeled data, consent, retention, thresholding, and export limits sebelum menyatukan data lintas sistem.

learning_objective_summary: Spreadsheet dan SQL digunakan untuk membersihkan, menggabungkan, dan menganalisis data secara reproducible. Spreadsheet cocok untuk QA/ad hoc, tetapi raw data besar memerlukan structured query. SQL mengharuskan analyst memahami SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, JOIN, CTE, window functions, date handling, nulls, and aggregation. Query yang benar secara sintaks masih dapat salah secara bisnis jika grain atau join relationship keliru.

learning_objective_summary: Descriptive analytics menjawab apa yang terjadi; diagnostic analytics menyelidiki mengapa. Analyst memeriksa trend, segment, variance, distribution, cohort, seasonality, mix shifts, and anomalies. Diagnosis memerlukan hypothesis tree dan triangulasi, bukan korelasi sederhana. Perubahan performa dapat disebabkan media delivery, audience/creative, landing page, tracking, product, stock, price, or sales operations.

recommended_remediation: Add a synthetic performance-drop diagnostic case with a hypothesis tree, decomposition, segment checks, tracking/product/stock/price controls and an evidence-based cause disposition.

learning_objective_summary: Attribution membagi credit conversion berdasarkan rule/model, sedangkan incrementality mengestimasi tambahan outcome yang disebabkan media dibanding counterfactual. Marketing effectiveness mempertimbangkan contribution, halo/cross-channel, brand, sales, and long-term effects. Platform ROAS tidak otomatis mengukur incremental return. Analyst perlu memahami last-click, data-driven, multi-touch, lift test, geo holdout, MMM, and their assumptions and data needs.

learning_objective_summary: Experiment design membutuhkan hypothesis, randomization unit, control/treatment, primary metric, guardrails, sample size, duration, stopping rule, and contamination controls. Statistik dasar seperti confidence interval, power, significance, variance, and multiple testing memengaruhi interpretasi. Significance bukan ukuran business impact; analyst harus memeriksa effect size, practical significance, data quality, and segment effects.

learning_objective_summary: Insight storytelling mengubah analisis menjadi keputusan yang dapat dipahami executive. Struktur yang efektif memuat question, context, key finding, evidence, driver, business impact, recommendation, risk, and next action. Analyst harus memisahkan fact, interpretation, hypothesis, and recommendation; visual mendukung narasi, bukan menutupi uncertainty. Komunikasi harus menyesuaikan audience tanpa mengubah data.

Data pipeline harus reproducible dan dapat diaudit. Bila memakai data synthetic/demo, jelaskan generator, assumptions, and limitations.
